name: Continuous Ledger
prompt: High-fidelity desktop healthcare operations UI composition at 1440 x 900. Clinic software only, not the mentoring portal. Clinical Wayfinding Ledger direction: a calm, crisp, professional operational ledger with a restrained deep-sage navigation rail, white working surface, cool off-white canvas, dark slate-green text, quiet borders, and no gradients, glass, decorative illustration, oversized cards, or ornamental shadows. Show Northfield Clinic and a Tracking Board page with a compact context header, explicit snapshot freshness and data-boundary wording, stage filters with counts, and one dominant continuous table. Reading order: patient, operational status and schedule timing, location and provider ownership state, reason and recorded care context, then explicit next action. Use 16px primary text, 14px secondary text, tabular numerals, sentence case, restrained status tags, and high information density without crowding. Late is operational timing, not clinical priority; missing and unrecorded states are explicit; no red/green acuity ladder. Desktop-first but structurally viable for tablet horizontal scrolling. Option A: Continuous Ledger, the most conventional and comparison-efficient composition.
